content.rendered: Once again, Middleton has teamed up with Sherwood 4 Kid’s Sake to sponsor local families in need.  Our annual Holiday Toy Drive For Kids will start Monday, November 27th and run until Wednesday, December 13th.  If you would like to be a part of this Middleton tradition, see our Snowflake bulletin board located in the main entrance hallway.  Please take a snowflake from the board and take it to the office.  There you will be able to sign out a gift tag of your choice.  Students are not allowed to take a snowflake from the board unless they have a parent with them or a note saying they can chose a snowflake and sign out a gift tag to take home.  Thank you in advance for your support and being a part of this Middleton annual tradition.
